//typescript: Pinned to 6.x ON PURPOSE — do not raise to match the root. TypeScript 7 no longer exposes the compiler API surface TypeDoc reads (`ts.SyntaxKind` is undefined), so TypeDoc crashes on import before it looks at a single source file, and 0.28.20 (latest) still declares `typescript: 5.0.x .. 6.0.x`. Nothing here is compiled with it: TypeDoc only parses the packages' sources to emit api/, while the packages themselves build with the root TypeScript 7 via tsdown. Raise this only once TypeDoc's peer range covers 7.x.
//api: Builds ssplayer-core before TypeDoc. TypeDoc reads packages/*/src, but ssplayer-webgl and ssplayer-pixi import @spritestudio/ssplayer-core by name, which resolves to its dist/*.d.ts: without that dist every such import fails with TS2307 and TypeDoc writes no api/, and a stale one documents the renderers against the old core.
